This is very small right now so I don't know if #announce is appropriate for this, but I started a basic plotting library that draws to the info view. Currently only supports float-valued functions. Link is https://github.com/alok/asciiplot. Notably the entire codebase was done by Cursor automatically iterating on type errors, I just asked it to do ASCII plotting.

Here's a diagram it did:
